build_equiformer_v2_model: build an EquiformerV2_OC20 equivariant GNN model with configurable SO(2) graph attention and spherical harmonic representations
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on molecular graph data to predict energy and forces using the EquiformerV2 model
review_transblockv2_layers: review the TransBlockV2 transformer blocks that perform SO(2) equivariant graph attention and feedforward network updates
refactor_normalization_layers: refactor the EquiformerV2 model to swap between layer_norm, layer_norm_sh, and rms_norm_sh normalization types
summarize_output_blocks: summarize the energy_block and force_block output heads that produce scalar energy and 3D force predictions
